sloka: मन्युर् न च त्वया कार्यो देवि ब्रूहि तव अग्रतः ।यास्यामि भव सुप्रीता वनम् चीर जटा धरः ॥२-१९-४॥
transliteration: manyur na ca tvayā kāryo devi brūhi tava agrataḥ ।yāsyāmi bhava suprītā vanam cīra jaṭā dharaḥ ॥2-19-4॥

translations.english: O Devi you should not grieve. I declare in your presence that I shall go to the forest wearing tattered clothes (bark) and matted locks. Rejoice (to hear this).
